text:
Rae (Product): dropped a prototype of a slim p95 panel and heatmap into Figma https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE — can we quick-iterate on hover behavior and sampling placement?

Lina (Design): two ideas: 1) small right-side overlay that keeps scrubber visible; 2) full-width bottom popover for mobile. prefer overlay on desktop.

Omar (Frontend): overlay ok on wide screens. bottom popover needed for <=640px. note: avoid overlap with tooltip and ensure focus management.

Dev (Eng): accessibility: when opening via keyboard, move focus into the panel and trap it until closed; Esc returns focus. use `role=dialog` and announce with `aria-live` for dynamic numbers.

Nina (PM): microcopy: keep hover line tight: "p95: 310 ms • n=860". add a small "View details" link.

a11y-bot: auto-scan: ensure scrubber thumb is >=44px, has `aria-valuenow`/`aria-valuetext`, and Left/Right keys adjust time. Popover should be reachable by keyboard and announced on open.

Lina (Design): palette change request: switch heatmap ramp to a colorblind-safe ramp (Viridis). add legend text: "darker = more requests".

Omar (Frontend): implement per-card sampling with org default fallback. hide advanced controls under a gear. will lazy-load the overlay data after first open to save payload.

Dev (Eng): backend can expose sample counts per bucket — show as "n=860" to indicate confidence. also return bucket timestamps so the scrubber snaps correctly.

Lina (Design): responsive legend: 3 buckets on mobile, 5 on desktop. ensure legend squares have descriptive alt text for screen readers.

Rae (Product): decisions: overlay on desktop, bottom popover on mobile, per-card sampling behind gear, colorblind ramp, short microcopy. Lina to update Figma, Omar/Dev to prototype keyboard + lazy-load, Nina to update docs.

Omar (Frontend): will prototype key handlers and debounced scrubber seeking.

Lina (Design): updated Figma pushed, left a11y notes. ping me for final pass.

Rae (Product): thanks — closing thread, will merge changes into spec.
